en: Ah, just as I thought... We can reach{SAUT}the tree trunks from this side.{PAGE}It may be best to chop these into smaller{SAUT}pieces and get them out of our way.
We would need some kind of axe for{SAUT}that. Thankfully, we don't absolutely{SAUT}need to open this path up―
Oh―! If you need an axe, why not just{SAUT}leave it to me?
How about it, Joker? I think I can{SAUT}get those trees out of the way!
Go for it, Noir.{OPTION}Let's leave them be.
Yeah, leave it to me! It's just a scaled-up{SAUT}version of chopping firewood...
Wh-Whoa... Holy cow, Noir! How...{SAUT}How are you twirling while doing that!?
...And there we go! How was that?
Thank you for your hard work. That'll{SAUT}make exploring this area much easier.
No thanks necessary―all I did was{SAUT}chop away!{PAGE}After all, everyone else helped out{SAUT}with hauling away the pieces...
Yeah! We just couldn't let you bear that{SAUT}burden yourself. Leave the heavy lifting{SAUT}to us strong men!
All YOU did was watch! Sheesh...
*giggle* Thank you for your help,{SAUT}everyone. Well then, let's go!
Very well. We'll leave this as is for now.
